construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

shared_schema.context: Government form JSON with citizen, service request, benefits application and preferences; policies with regulation text and service metadata; feedback; support question.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate_state layer checks exact fields, bounds, types, synthetic labeling, privacy, source references, stage order, deterministic stage results, and audit provenance. Application steps must occur in supplied policy text.
shared_schema.error_contract: One JSON object with status=error, exit 2; errors do not echo source text or paths.
shared_schema.success_contract: One JSON object with status=ok, exit 0; no files written by runtime.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated evidence-backed service catalog, question and policy identifiers.
Validated ranked service IDs select feedback for theme extraction.
Validated service-specific theme actions shape support alongside retained policy evidence and recommendations.

behavior.research: Deterministic word overlap selects supplied policies, evidence sentences and service catalog. Unmatched questions retain an explicit evidence gap.
behavior.recommend: Three points per stated-interest word and one per request word. Zero-score services excluded; service-ID tie break. No benefit approval.
behavior.insights: Visible keyword themes; selected-service feedback only; counts, ratings, feedback references, actions and small-sample caveat. Multiple themes can overlap.
behavior.support: Matches the support question to recommended services. Returns short numbered policy steps, citations and feedback-informed assistance. No evidence means abstain. Eligibility, appeals and urgent matters require a human.
behavior.privacy: Citizen contact fields and case/application identifiers are redacted across all strings before research. Other email addresses and phone-like digit strings are also redacted. Unknown form fields are rejected. No sensitive identifiers affect ranking. Only synthetic fixtures are accepted.
behavior.explainability: Ordered audit trail, cited policy IDs, evidence excerpts, matched terms, transparent ranking and feedback IDs support open-records review of this synthetic demonstration.
behavior.accessibility: English-only plain-language templates, short source steps, numbered lists and accessible-format guidance demonstrate Section 508 spirit; this is not an accessibility certification.

included: Synthetic citizen service requests, benefits applications and invented policy text
One integrated deterministic pipeline with immutable input and shared schema validation
Privacy Act/GDPR-inspired data minimization and output redaction demonstrations
FOIA/open-records-inspired explanations, traceable evidence and audit rules
CLI error handling and standard-library tests without persistent test artifacts
excluded: Real citizen data; free-text entity recognition is not a comprehensive PII detector
Production security, compliance certification, eligibility decisions or legal advice
Live government policy verification, external search, networking, models and providers
Translation, semantic reasoning, authentication, storage, web UI or case submission
Claim that synthetic source text is authoritative or immune to malicious content

cli.stdout: One valid JSON object with status=ok and stage=support
